rationale: Era's Edge lab is building sovereign, on-device AI infrastructure with a focus on edge intelligence and open-source composability, while Arya is shipping agentic tools (LeSearch AI, LeCoder MConnect) that need exactly this kind of lightweight, mobile-first foundation. Both are in San Francisco, share TypeScript as a working language, and complement each other: Era brings deep-tech operator experience and conviction around edge inference winning over centralized cloud, while Arya brings hands-on agentic systems expertise and mobile-first product instincts that could shape how Edge's infrastructure gets deployed.
intro_message: Era Qian, meet Arya Teja Rudraraju — Era's building sovereign edge AI infrastructure at Edge, and Arya's shipping mobile-first agentic tools that could be a natural fit for on-device deployment; both strong TypeScript practitioners in SF working at the frontier of agent-first and edge-first AI.
